implementation.ownership: Original launchProofs entry for the pre-/new target supplies fixture-owned pane/process identity. Successor pane and full original process tuple must match it. The observed tmux socket must match this run's dedicated private socket. Native launch attestation and valid exact pane/process fields are required before probing or teardown.
implementation.destructive_check_classification: One-directional safety brakes: removing ownership checks could broaden teardown. Not product lifecycle or retention policy.
implementation.teardown: If the owned pane remains in the private socket's pane list, retain its measured viewport and exact kill-pane command before closing only that pane. Already absent means no close. A raced close error is provisional only when recheck confirms the pane disappeared and actual ESRCH subsequently proves original host death.
implementation.death: Retain old native/Pij identity and unmodified original process tuple. Production probe calls process.kill(originalPid, 0); only thrown code ESRCH proves death. No global PID kill, no fake liveness, no tuple mutation, no identity waiver. Pane disappearance alone is insufficient.
implementation.failure: Retain original teardown exception across failed recheck, death timeout, or permission-denied probe. Secondary diagnostics stay in teardown_recheck_error/death_proof_error. Failed proof prevents resume; original native-control evidence remains separate.
implementation.resume: Await stopSmokeNativeHost before existing fresh manual --resume; no Pij preallocation. Existing same native session/Pij address, fresh process tuple, subsequent native delivery, single acknowledgement and old-context exclusion assertions are unchanged.
